Proceedings. Mr. Thelen appeared for the Police.
Mr. Yue Kyung An appeared for the accused.

Accused :- I live at 141, Rue Pere Robert.

Mr. Thelen then re-outlined the case.

C.D.C.18 :-At 1.0 p.m. on the 1/6 last I received information
that a meeting was being held at Chekiang and Foochow Roads corner
so I proceeded thence and saw the accused in front of a crowd of
people by a lodging house. He was shouting slogans at the time -
"Down with the Kuomintang" and "Death to Chiang-Kai-Shek". He was
arrested and at first gave a wrong address in P'Town but later took
us to the address in Rue Pere Robert. 55 Communist books were found
there. He then took us to another house in the French Concession
where we unearthed some more books. That house was not occupied by
the accused but by a man named Lee Kyl Hwa.

C.D.C.274 :- Corroborated and added that he heard the accused
shout" Down with Imperialism" on Foochow Road. He attempted to
run away but I overtook and arrested him. There were no papers in
his possession but a number lay scattered over the road. I do not
know who threw them. I heard him shouting and saw him gesticulating
with his hand to his mouth.

Accused :- At 12.00 a.m. that day I took tiffin in Lee Kyl
Hwa 's house as my own had been burnt down in Chapei. I had gone
to Nanking Road to purchase a few new articles to replace those
destroyed. As I passed Foochow Road I saw a crowd and endeavoured
to force my way through but could not. I heard some men shouting so
I heard "Robbers " mentioned I ran away. I fell down in doing so and
a C.P.C. arrested me. I did not shout slogans and I did not hear
what those who did said. I heard some shouting but I did not notice
any one gesticulating. I do not know how many books were seized by
the Police but there were a number in the room. They were not all
of a Communistic nature however. Those taken have been selected
from amongst them. I am not a Communist and am not in sympathy

诉讼程序。Thelen先生代表警方出庭。
Yue Kyung An先生代表被告出庭。

被告：- 我住在罗伯特神父路（Rue Pere Robert）141号。

随后Thelen先生重新概述了案情。

C.D.C.18：- 昨天（6月1日）下午1点，我接到情报称
在浙江路和福州路拐角处正在举行集会，
于是我前往该处，在一所寄宿房屋前的人群中看到了被告。
当时他正在高呼口号——
“打倒国民党”和“杀死蒋介石”。他被捕后，起初在蒲石路（P'Town）报了一个错误的地址，但后来带我们去了罗伯特神父路的地址。在那里发现了55本共产主义书籍。随后他又带我们去了法租界的另一所房子，在那里我们又查获了一些书籍。那所房子并非由被告居住，而是由一个叫Lee Kyl Hwa的人居住。

C.D.C.274：- 证实了上述情况并补充说，他听到被告在福州路高呼“打倒帝国主义”。被告试图逃跑，但我追上并逮捕了他。他身上没有携带文件，但路上散落着一些文件。我不知道是谁扔的。我听到他在喊叫，并看到他用手指着嘴巴做手势。

被告：- 当天中午12点，我在Lee Kyl Hwa家吃午饭，因为我在闸北的家被烧毁了。我去南京路购买了一些新物品以替换那些被毁的物品。当我经过福州路时，我看到一群人，试图挤过去但未能成功。我听到一些人在喊叫，所以我听到有人提到“强盗”，我就逃跑了。我在逃跑时摔倒了，一名华捕逮捕了我。我没有高呼口号，也没有听到那些喊叫的人说了什么。我听到一些喊叫声，但没有注意到任何人做手势。我不知道警方查获了多少本书，但房间里确实有一些。然而，这些书并不都是共产主义性质的。被拿走的书是从中挑选出来的。我不是共产党员，也不同情

My name is Dong Mei Nyi (董曼尼) age 20 years, native
of Nanchang in the Province of Kiangsi. Until I was 10 years
of age I studied at home under my father who was a teacher in
the Nanchang Primary School. Upon attaining my tenth year
I entered my father's school where I studied primary subjects.
At thirteen I entered the Nanchang Middle School where I again
studied primary subjects. By ending of my 16th years I passed
to the senior class and was converted to Christianity. In my
18th year I graduated from the Nanchang Middle School and
entered the National Central University at Nanking. During
my two years there I studied chiefly western classical literature
interspersed with political economy, commerce, philosophy and
and I graduated in month of February. During my second year at
the National Central University I married Wong Kai Woo (王開湖)
a native of Hupeh who was a clerk at the Ministry of Education
and between February and September 1931 I resided at Yue Cha
Chao, Nanking. In September I came to Shanghai to see the
Manager of the Ching Woo and Nanking Party Book Shop situated
on North Szechuen Road, which company had offered to reprint
some translations which I had been engaged during my stay in
Nanking and upon my arrival here I went to live with Professor
Lee Chang Hwa (李劍華) of the Fu-Tan College, who resided on
North Szechuen Road. ( I have forgotten the number). After
residing there for one month I returned to Nanking to bring my
wife to Shanghai, upon our arrival here we went to live at No. 450
Kiangwan Road, we remained there until the end of January at which
times the Sino Japanese Hostilities made it impossible for us to

在那里居住，房屋也被完全摧毁。于是我们前往一位名叫刘道恒（Liu Tao Hun (劉道恒)）的朋友家，他是一名金业经纪人，住在法租界查萨尔路（Rue Chasal）208号，大约一个月前刘离开了上海，由于我无法继续在那里居住，我搬到了罗伯特神父路（Route Fere Robert）141号。自从我来到上海，我写了一部《中国文学史》，但不幸在江湾的家中被烧毁，今天大约上午11点，我离开家前往李教授家，他现在住在赫维德西斯路（Route Terve de Sieyes）新民里76号，我在那里吃了一顿饭，下午1点离开前往南京路进行各种采购。
当我到达福州路时，我看到一大群人，其中一些人在高呼口号，在我还没来得及走出人群时，就被警察逮捕并带到了本巡捕房。
随后对我在罗伯特神父路住所的搜查导致发现了一些书籍，我购买这些书籍是为了研究现代思潮的趋势。我声明我不是共产党员，也没有成为共产党员的意图。
